## 🌊 Numerical Algorithm: 2D Wave Equation

The propagation of linear surface waves on water or acoustic waves in a medium is governed by the 2D hyperbolic wave equation:
$$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \left( \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} \right) - \gamma \frac{\partial u}{\partial t}$$
where $u(x,y,t)$ is the wave amplitude, $c$ is the wave propagation velocity, and $\gamma$ is a damping coefficient.

### Finite Difference Leapfrog Discretization
Using central differences on a spatial mesh with grid spacing $\Delta x = \Delta y = h$:
$$\frac{u_{i,j}^{n+1} - 2u_{i,j}^n + u_{i,j}^{n-1}}{\Delta t^2} \approx c^2 \left[ \frac{u_{i+1,j}^n + u_{i-1,j}^n + u_{i,j+1}^n + u_{i,j-1}^n - 4u_{i,j}^n}{h^2} \right] - \gamma \frac{u_{i,j}^n - u_{i,j}^{n-1}}{\Delta t}$$

Solving for the updated wave height $u_{i,j}^{n+1}$:
$$u_{i,j}^{n+1} = \frac{1}{1 + \gamma \Delta t/2} \left[ 2u_{i,j}^n - u_{i,j}^{n-1}(1 - \gamma \Delta t/2) + \frac{c^2 \Delta t^2}{h^2} \nabla_5^2 u_{i,j}^n \right]$$

### CFL Stability Criterion
For stability, the Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) number must satisfy:
$$\text{CFL} = \frac{c \Delta t}{h} \le \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \approx 0.7071$$

## 🎮 Interactive Simulation

*Click or drag anywhere in the pond below to create wave disturbances, or toggle the double-slit barrier to witness interference fringes.*

```{=html}
<div style="background: #111a1a; border: 1px solid #1e3a3a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; margin-bottom: 25px; color: #d0f0e0;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 15px; margin-bottom: 15px; align-items: center;">
    <div>
      <label style="font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #5ce1e6;">Wave Speed $c$: <span id="val-c">0.85</span></label><br>
      <input type="range" id="slider-c" min="0.4" max="1.2" step="0.05" value="0.85" style="width: 130px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #7af57a;">Damping $\gamma$: <span id="val-damp">0.003</span></label><br>
      <input type="range" id="slider-damp" min="0.000" max="0.015" step="0.001" value="0.003" style="width: 130px;">
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px;">
      <button id="btn-slits" style="background: #194d4d; border: 1px solid #339999; color: #fff; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">Toggle Double Slit</button>
      <button id="btn-pulse" style="background: #1f6650; border: 1px solid #38b000; color: #fff; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">Periodic Source</button>
      <button id="btn-clear" style="background: #442222; border: 1px solid #883333; color: #fff; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">Clear Pond</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="text-align: center;">
    <canvas id="wave-canvas" width="400" height="300" style="background: #050d0d; border: 1px solid #134e5e; border-radius: 6px; width: 100%; max-width: 680px; height: auto; cursor: crosshair;"></canvas>
    <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #88c0a0; margin-top: 6px;">Click and drag in the tank to perturb water level. Blue = Crest, Red = Trough.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('wave-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const NX = 160;
  const NY = 120;
  let uPrev = new Float32Array(NX * NY);
  let uCurr = new Float32Array(NX * NY);
  let uNext = new Float32Array(NX * NY);
  let obstacles = new Uint8Array(NX * NY);

  let waveSpeed = 0.85;
  let damping = 0.003;
  let hasSlits = false;
  let periodicSource = false;
  let frameCount = 0;

  const sC = document.getElementById('slider-c');
  const sDamp = document.getElementById('slider-damp');
  const lC = document.getElementById('val-c');
  const lDamp = document.getElementById('val-damp');
  const bSlits = document.getElementById('btn-slits');
  const bPulse = document.getElementById('btn-pulse');
  const bClear = document.getElementById('btn-clear');

  sC.addEventListener('input', () => { waveSpeed = parseFloat(sC.value); lC.textContent = waveSpeed; });
  sDamp.addEventListener('input', () => { damping = parseFloat(sDamp.value); lDamp.textContent = damping; });

  function setObstacles() {
    obstacles.fill(0);
    if (!hasSlits) return;
    const midX = Math.floor(NX * 0.4);
    const slit1 = Math.floor(NY * 0.38);
    const slit2 = Math.floor(NY * 0.62);
    const slitWidth = 5;

    for (let y = 0; y < NY; y++) {
      if (Math.abs(y - slit1) > slitWidth && Math.abs(y - slit2) > slitWidth) {
        for (let x = midX - 1; x <= midX + 1; x++) {
          obstacles[y * NX + x] = 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  bSlits.addEventListener('click', () => {
    hasSlits = !hasSlits;
    bSlits.style.background = hasSlits ? '#2c8c8c' : '#194d4d';
    setObstacles();
  });

  bPulse.addEventListener('click', () => {
    periodicSource = !periodicSource;
    bPulse.style.background = periodicSource ? '#2dc653' : '#1f6650';
  });

  bClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
    uPrev.fill(0); uCurr.fill(0); uNext.fill(0);
  });

  function disturb(canvasX, canvasY, radius, strength) {
    const gx = Math.floor((canvasX / canvas.clientWidth) * NX);
    const gy = Math.floor((canvasY / canvas.clientHeight) * NY);
    for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {
      for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
        const x = gx + dx, y = gy + dy;
        if (x > 1 && x < NX - 2 && y > 1 && y < NY - 2) {
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          if (dist <= radius) {
            uCurr[y * NX + x] += strength * Math.cos((dist / radius) * (Math.PI / 2));
            uPrev[y * NX + x] += strength * Math.cos((dist / radius) * (Math.PI / 2));
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  let isDragging = false;
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    disturb(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top, 5, 2.5);
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => isDragging = false);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    disturb(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top, 4, 1.2);
  });

  // Render Image buffer
  const imgData = ctx.createImageData(NX, NY);
  const data = imgData.data;

  function stepPhysics() {
    frameCount++;
    const alpha = (waveSpeed * waveSpeed) * 0.45; // CFL safe parameter
    const dampFactor = 1.0 - damping;

    if (periodicSource) {
      const srcX = Math.floor(NX * 0.15);
      const srcY = Math.floor(NY * 0.5);
      uCurr[srcY * NX + srcX] = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.25) * 3.0;
    }

    for (let y = 1; y < NY - 1; y++) {
      const row = y * NX;
      for (let x = 1; x < NX - 1; x++) {
        const idx = row + x;
        if (obstacles[idx]) {
          uNext[idx] = 0;
          continue;
        }
        const laplacian = uCurr[idx - 1] + uCurr[idx + 1] + uCurr[idx - NX] + uCurr[idx + NX] - 4 * uCurr[idx];
        uNext[idx] = (2 * uCurr[idx] - uPrev[idx] + alpha * laplacian) * dampFactor;
      }
    }

    // Cycle arrays
    const temp = uPrev;
    uPrev = uCurr;
    uCurr = uNext;
    uNext = temp;
  }

  function render() {
    let p = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < NX * NY; i++) {
      if (obstacles[i]) {
        data[p] = 120; data[p+1] = 130; data[p+2] = 140; data[p+3] = 255;
      } else {
        const val = uCurr[i];
        if (val >= 0) {
          // Blue-cyan crest
          const c = Math.min(255, Math.floor(val * 90));
          data[p] = Math.floor(c * 0.2);
          data[p+1] = Math.floor(c * 0.7);
          data[p+2] = c;
        } else {
          // Red-orange trough
          const c = Math.min(255, Math.floor(-val * 90));
          data[p] = c;
          data[p+1] = Math.floor(c * 0.25);
          data[p+2] = Math.floor(c * 0.1);
        }
        data[p+3] = 255;
      }
      p += 4;
    }

    // Scale onto canvas
    createImageBitmap(imgData).then(bmp => {
      ctx.drawImage(bmp, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    });
  }

  function anim() {
    stepPhysics();
    stepPhysics(); // 2 sub-steps for fluidity
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(anim);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(anim);
})();
</script>
```
